description: Implementation of the Normal (Gaussian) distribution class with methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative, sampling, and distribution parameters.

classes.name: NormalDistribution
classes.description: Class representing a normal distribution with methods to compute density, distribution functions, and generate random samples.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given point.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cumulative distribution function (quantile) for a given probability.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability for a range between two points.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution, as used in numerical computations.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.
